transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I've been struggling a lot with focusing and staying on task lately. It feels really hard to sustain my attention on things, whether it's at work or just trying to get daily chores done.
Have problems with attention and staying organized been present since childhood, or did they start more recently? Was there any major stress or mood change around the time they began?

These issues actually started back in childhood, definitely before I was 12, but they've been consistently really bad for about a year and 11 months now. I don't recall any major life stressors or mood changes happening around the time they started.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about many different things, and when that happens, is it the worry itself that makes it hard to concentrate?
I don't really experience that kind of constant worrying. I don't think anxiety is the cause of my concentration difficulties, as my mind just seems to drift off even when I'm completely calm.
Besides trouble focusing, do you also often lose things, forget appointments or tasks, and have trouble organizing, and do these problems happen in more than one setting like work and home?

To be honest, I don't really experience losing my things, forgetting appointments, or having trouble keeping things organized. Since those aren't really issues for me, I'm not sure about them happening across different settings like work and home.
Do you often make careless mistakes, avoid tasks that require long mental effort, seem not to listen when spoken to, or get easily distracted by things around you?

I definitely get very easily distracted by things going on around me, and my mind often drifts off to unrelated thoughts. However, I don't really struggle with making careless mistakes, avoiding tasks, or not listening when people are talking to me.
Have these attention problems caused clear difficulties in at least two areas of your life, such as work, home, school, or relationships?

Yes, they definitely cause clear difficulties in multiple areas of my life. I really struggle to finish chores at home and often fail to complete my work duties because I just can't seem to follow through on instructions and finish what I start.
Do you often have trouble following through on instructions or finishing tasks, and do you often seem not to listen when spoken to directly?

Yes, I definitely struggle with following through on instructions and often fail to finish tasks or chores that I start. As for appearing not to listen when spoken to directly, I'm not as sure about that and don't think it's really an issue for me.
When a task takes a long time or a lot of mental effort, do you often avoid it or put it off?
I wouldn't say I avoid starting tasks that require a lot of effort. My main issue is that once I do start them, I really struggle to stay focused on them or actually finish them.
Do you often make careless mistakes or miss details on work or other tasks even when you understand what to do?
I don't really struggle with making careless mistakes or missing details on my tasks. That hasn't really been a major issue for me.
Do you often have trouble holding your attention during reading, meetings, or conversations, even when you want to pay attention?

Yes, I frequently struggle to maintain my focus during meetings, reading, or conversations, even when I am actively trying to pay attention. My mind often just drifts away to other thoughts, making it really hard to stay engaged.
